item.title: Vietnam’s VinFast unveils new ultra-luxury electric vehicle
item.description: VinFast, the electric vehicle manufacturer under Vietnam's conglomerate Vingroup, has unveiled two new ultra-luxury electric models, as part of a broader restructuring of its automotive portfolio.

item.title: Canvas Ventures International aims to build operating system for Thailand’s Next Economy [Q&A]
item.description: We talked to Tanachai Kulsomboonsin, CEO and Co-founder at Canvas Ventures International, to learn more about the VC firm’s achievements in 2025 and its plans and aspirations for 2026. He also shared his views on the outlook of tech ecosystem in Thailand for 2026.

item.title: Vietnam imposes mandatory AI labeling under new law
item.description: Vietnam’s Law on Artificial Intelligence (AI) stipulates that service providers must inform users when they are interacting with AI; otherwise, they may be subject to criminal proceedings or administrative fines.

item.title: Gobi Partners invests in Cortical Labs, expands biological computing hub
item.description: Asia-focused venture capital firm Gobi Partners has invested in Cortical Labs, a biotechnology company developing computing systems that combine living human neurons with silicon hardware.

item.title: Singapore-based Open Campus, Vietnam’s L&A and SKALE pilot credential-based job matching
item.description: Open Campus, a Singapore-based decentralized autonomous organization (DAO) focused on blockchain applications in education, will collaborate with Vietnam’s Le & Associates (L&A) and SKALE to pilot a credential-powered job matching initiative in Vietnam.

item.title: Malaysia’s Aonic secures $10M to take home-grown drone technology global
item.description: The Series A funding round is led by Kairous Capital, a regional private equity and venture capital firm backed by Jelawang Capital, Malaysia’s National Fund-of-Funds through its Emerging Fund Managers’ Program.

item.title: From chatbots to sales AI agents: The evolution of AI in e-commerce
item.description: E-commerce is entering a new era where AI does far more than answer questions. The shift from chatbots to Sales AI Agents is not about replacing old tools. It is about meeting modern shoppers where they are and giving them the help they expect.

item.title: Malaysia’s Carsome delivers $23M EBITDA in FY2025, 16% gross profit growth
item.description: CARSOME Group Inc. reported FY2025 EBITDA of $23 million, more than doubling year-on-year, reflecting continued margin expansion and cost discipline across its core markets.

item.title: How to create content that keeps readers engaged
item.description: Creating content that keeps readers engaged requires a mix of psychology, storytelling, smart formatting, and consistency. By focusing on what your audience truly values, you can design content that entertains, educates, and inspires. And by applying lessons from proven strategies you can ensure your content doesn’t just capture attention but holds it, transforming readers into a community that keeps coming back for more.

item.title: Sea’s revenue rises 36.4 percent year on year in 2025
item.description: Singapore-based tech giant Sea saw its revenue jump 36.4 percent year on year to $22.9 billion in 2025, with gross profit growing 42.2 percent year-on-year to $10.2 billion.
